anti_overlap: Spatial role and frame questions — whether a symbol is a node, an edge, an axis, or a reference frame, and the geometry of where it sits relative to the being space — owned by the wayfinding/reference-frame reviewer.

Relatedness-universe volume and V-shrinkage mechanics, graph topology, and node-count effects on the similarity build — defer to the wayfinding reviewer; this reviewer touches the relatedness layer only where a grade is laundered across it.

Interval-versus-point representation of a coordinate as a precision question — defer to the wayfinding reviewer's expanded-target framing; this reviewer owns only what the attestation licenses as a claim, not how the claim is shaped in space.
decision_lens: For every axis proposed for a symbol, first name the object it measures — the figure as portrayed, or the attestation set — and treat any axis whose object silently changes between the being tier and the symbol tier as a comparability illusion rather than a shared spine, no matter that the axis name and range match. For every admission claim, demand independence verified at each generation rather than a count of sources at the top. For every gap, demand which of four states it is — inapplicable, unattested, contested, contradicted — and reject a structure that can only write a number and a confidence. Prefer grade-separated collections with explicit cross-collection citation over one schema carrying mixed grades, and rank an option worse when it launders a weakly-attested entry into a strongly-attested computation than when it is merely thin.
distance_rationale: This is a non-Western scholarly discipline with twelve centuries of refinement whose entire subject matter is the one thing this design keeps eliding: the difference between a property of a report and a property of the thing reported. It shares no parent discipline with navigation, statistics, software engineering, or any banned AI-cliche domain, and it arrived independently at machinery this brief is reinventing badly — a formal grade attached to the chain rather than the content, a threshold theory of how many independent transmissions constitute a different epistemic kind, a rule that a chain break is categorically not the same as a weak link, and a settled practice of keeping differently-graded material in separate collections rather than one schema with a confidence column. The brief's own observation that Adaptability on a symbol reads as 'how much the meaning shifts across traditions' is a matn-variance observation stated in referent language; isnād criticism is the discipline that names why that substitution is fatal to comparability. Its common-link analysis is also the sharpest available attack on 'attested in two or more independent sources' and on pairwise-deletion covariance, both of which assume an independence that must be verified layer by layer and usually is not.
expected_isomorphisms: matn versus isnād — a grade attaches to the report and its chain, never to the referent ↔ the axis-semantics fault line: on a being, Adaptability is offered as a property of the figure as portrayed; on a symbol it degrades into a property of the attestation set (how much the meaning shifts across traditions). The same axis name measuring two different objects is a comparability illusion, and it is the fault the entire discipline exists to prevent.

the tawātur spectrum — mutawātir (so many independent chains at every generation that collusion is inconceivable) versus mashhūr versus āḥād (single-strand, admissible but never certainty-grade) ↔ '952 attested in two or more independent sources': two is deep in āḥād territory, and Rainbow's nine sources are a corroboration claim only if the nine are independent at every layer rather than nine relays of one compiler.

common link (madār) analysis — chains that appear to be many but converge on a single transmitter are one report wearing many isnāds ↔ two distinct failures at once: the promotion population's independence claim, and the covariance gate's pairwise deletion, which computes every pair's estimate on a different and non-independent sub-population and then assembles them into a matrix as if they were commensurable.

the break taxonomy — mursal and munqaṭiʿ (a missing link) is categorically different from ḍaʿīf (a present but weak link), and no amount of corroboration cures a break the way it cures weakness (ḥasan li-ghayrihi) ↔ the conflation this design is about to freeze: not-applicable, not-attested, contested, and contradicted are four different states, and a strict 29-key schema plus five never-not-applicable universal axes forces all four to be written as a number with a confidence.

ṭabaqāt layering and grade-separated collections — the ṣaḥīḥ compilations are kept as their own books rather than merged into one corpus with a grade column, precisely so that a weak report cannot be laundered by proximity ↔ the separate-collection question: whether symbols get their own schema and their own grades, and what discipline stops an āḥād-grade symbol from entering being↔being similarity at ṣaḥīḥ-grade weight through a shared spine.

iḍṭirāb (irreconcilable variance across transmissions) and riwāya bi'l-maʿnā (transmission by sense, where wording drifts but the report is still sound) ↔ the proposed corpus-level axis family: spread, contestation and stability over time are recognisable as a grading apparatus about reports, not as more dimensions of the same vector — which argues for a second, parallel structure that beings would also carry, rather than extra keys in a 29-key schema.

tadlīs (a transmitter concealing an omission by phrasing that implies direct hearing) ↔ a confidence field and justification that assert corpus support while quietly spanning traditions that never mention each other — the failure mode where the record looks well-attested exactly because the gap was smoothed over in the gloss.
focus: Whether each proposed structure keeps clear which object an axis measures — the figure as portrayed, or the attestation set that portrays it — and whether the tier's admission machinery (source counts, confidence fields, the universal-5 requirement, pairwise-deletion covariance) rests on an independence and completeness that has been verified layer by layer rather than assumed from a count.
name: fd-isnad-attestation-grading
persona: Apply the perspective of a classical ḥadīth critic trained in isnād analysis and rijāl scholarship — a discipline whose first and last question about any report is not 'is this true' but 'what exactly is graded here, the chain or the content, and who is in the chain at every generation.' This reviewer treats a source count as an unverified claim until independence is checked at each layer, hears 'attested in two or more independent sources' as an āḥād grade rather than a corroboration, and holds as settled that a broken chain is a different kind of defect from a weak one — corroboration cures weakness and never cures a break. It insists that differently-graded material lives in differently-bounded collections, distrusts any single schema whose confidence column is asked to carry four distinct states at once, and reads a smooth, well-formed justification spanning traditions that never met as the classic signature of concealment rather than of strength. It reasons in matn and isnād, ṭabaqāt, common links, tawātur thresholds, and grade separation — never in vectors, factors, or embeddings.
review_areas: Object-of-measurement audit across every axis in play: for each of the five universal axes (Adaptability, Consistency, Action Pace, Manifestation, Resilience), state what the axis measures on a being and what it would measure on a symbol, and flag every case where the object silently shifts from the figure-as-portrayed to the attestation set. Judge Options A and B specifically on whether their claimed comparability survives that audit or is a name collision.

Independence and grade of the promotion population: attack '4,839 rows, 952 attested in two or more independent sources' as an admission criterion — whether independence was verified at each layer or only at the top, whether Rainbow's nine and Beetle's eight converge on common links (shared compilers, one tradition relayed), what threshold would be defensible, and whether the symbol tier needs its own promotion criteria and its own grades rather than inheriting the being tier's.

The four-state gap taxonomy against the strict schema: distinguish inapplicable, unattested, contested, and contradicted, and assess what the 29-key requirement plus the five never-not-applicable universal axes force an author to write when the honest answer is one of the last three. Say specifically what a fabricated-by-requirement universal-axis value does to the covariance gate, to family clustering, and to the jawnsight grammar that derives player-visible traits.

Corroboration arithmetic versus pairwise deletion: examine whether the covariance gate's pairwise-deletion estimates are assembled from mutually non-independent sub-populations once symbols at 5/29 coverage enter, and whether the stamped baseline's max |r|, band census, named-cluster drift and per-vintage gores remain interpretable when each cell rests on a different and differently-graded population.

Grade separation and laundering paths: evaluate the separate-collection option on the discipline's own terms — differently-graded material in differently-bounded collections with explicit cross-collection citation — and trace every path by which a thinly-attested symbol could enter being↔being similarity, family clustering, or a jawnsight-derived trait at a weight its attestation does not support.

The corpus-level axis family as a parallel apparatus: assess whether spread, contestation, and stability-over-time belong as additional keys in the eidogen vector or as a separate grading structure that beings would also carry, what each choice does to the 29-key schema and the covariance baseline, and which of the two the jawnsight grammar should be permitted to read at all.

severity_examples.condition: When Option A or B is taken forward without an explicit per-axis statement of what the axis measures on each tier, and without a test that the two readings are the same kind of claim.
severity_examples.scenario: A shared universal-5 spine is adopted as the comparability mechanism when the five axes measure the figure-as-portrayed on a being and the attestation set on a symbol. Every being↔symbol distance, every family-clustering assignment that mixes tiers, and every jawnsight trait derived from a mixed neighbourhood is then computed across two different objects under one axis name — an error that is invisible in the data, survives all schema validation, and becomes unremovable once relations and derived traits cite it.

severity_examples.condition: When promotion criteria remain a source count with no per-layer independence verification and no grade attached to the symbol entry.
severity_examples.scenario: The 952-row population is promoted on a source count that was never checked for common links, so entries whose nine 'independent' attestations relay a single compiler are admitted at the same grade as genuinely multiply-attested ones — and the resulting tier is used to set the covariance baseline and the clustering universe, ratcheting a stamped gate against a population whose independence claim is false.

severity_examples.condition: When the design keeps the never-not-applicable rule for symbols without adding an explicit state field distinguishing inapplicable, unattested, contested, and contradicted.
severity_examples.scenario: Because the five universal axes can never be marked not-applicable, symbol authors write a mid-range value with low confidence where the honest state is unattested or contested. The confidence field carries four distinct states as one number, the justification reads as well-supported because the gap was smoothed in the gloss, and downstream consumers cannot recover which state they are reading.

source_domain: Classical ʿilm al-ḥadīth and ʿilm al-rijāl — the Islamic science of transmission-chain criticism refined from the 8th century onward: the matn/isnād split (the text of a report versus its chain of transmitters), grading (ṣaḥīḥ, ḥasan, ḍaʿīf, mawḍūʿ), the tawātur spectrum from mutawātir through mashhūr to āḥād, common-link (madār) analysis, tadlīs (concealed omission in a chain), the mursal/munqaṭiʿ break taxonomy, ḥasan li-ghayrihi corroboration rules, ṭabaqāt generational layering, iḍṭirāb (irreconcilable variance), and riwāya bi'l-maʿnā (transmission by sense rather than wording).
success_hints: Run the object-of-measurement audit first and axis by axis — the finding that a shared spine is a name collision rather than comparability is the highest-value output available and reframes Options A and B rather than merely scoring them.

Attack the source count concretely: name which of Rainbow (9), Beetle (8), Flood, Heaven, Lion, Turtle would most plausibly converge on a common link, and say what verification would look like, rather than asserting that independence is unproven.

Keep the four-state gap taxonomy explicit and carry it through every consumer — covariance gate, family clustering, jawnsight grammar — so the schema recommendation is a state field with named states, not a plea for more nuance.
When recommending grade separation, specify the citation contract across collections, since the laundering paths are what make separation load-bearing rather than tidy.

Treat the corpus-level axis family as a candidate second apparatus for both tiers, and say what beings would gain from carrying it — the brief raises this and it is the clearest route to an option nobody listed.
task_context: Determine how the jawnomicon symbol tier should be structured: what vector (if any) a symbol entry carries, how symbols relate to the existing 29-axis eidogen space for beings, and where symbols sit in the graph and relatedness layers. Surface options beyond the four already listed, especially any that question whether a symbol should be a node with coordinates at all. Attack each option against the measured constraints: the five universal axes, the covariance ratchet's pairwise-deletion estimates, the hygiene-09 V-shrinkage lesson, the strict 29-key creature schema, and the downstream jawnsight grammar. Target document: docs/symbol-tier-design-question.md (jawnomicon-nhe.3).
